messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Deducer - ggplot2 gsoc progress
parts:
For those who are interested I'm keeping a screen cast vlog of the development progress of the Deducer-ggplot2 GUI that is being developed over the summer. Updates will be posted on the R google summer of code blog. The first post has just gone up:

http://gsoc2010r.wordpress.com/2010/06/19/ggplot2-gui-progress/

The main point of this project is to create an elegant, and easy to use interface for building and sharing statistical graphics. It is being designed to be easy enough for beginners, and flexible enough for experts.

 Ian
